content:
The most recent UEFA Champions League final was played on May 28, 2022. The winner was Real Madrid, who defeated Liverpool 1-0 in the final.

The final was played at the Stade de France in Saint-Denis, France. The lone goal of the match was scored by Real Madrid's Vinicius Junior in the 59th minute.

This was Real Madrid's 14th UEFA Champions League title, further extending their record as the most successful club in the competition's history. It was also Real Madrid's fifth Champions League title in the last nine seasons.
